summary: Unslop Auto Plug structure: every plug sells the owner's offer, never Unslop, and follows five short lines (cheeky transition from the post, pain point, how the offer solves it, a free-to-try join line only with a verified, dated count and the owner's community word, then the exact saved link); the approval packet shows the multi-line plug and the join count source, and the gate, three-call limit and casing guard are unchanged.
